tasks.title: Conversation #113
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you going to the outdoor movie night in the park this Friday?
Woman: Yes. I heard they're showing a classic film. It should be fun.
Man: Definitely. I'm planning to bring some snacks in a blanket.
Woman: Good idea. I'll bring some drinks.
Man: Great. Let's meet up at the entrance around 7 p.m.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you going to the outdoor movie night in the park this Friday? 选项分析： A. A concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐演出，所以A选项错误。 B. A festival 节日活动。对话中未提及节日，所以B选项错误。 C. A movie night 电影之夜。男士明确提到“outdoor movie night”，所以C选项正确。 D. A play 话剧。对话中未提及话剧，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What is the woman planning to bring?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女士计划带什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Good idea. I'll bring some drinks. 选项分析： A. Snacks 零食。男士说他要带零食，不是女士，所以A选项错误。 B. A blanket 毯子。男士说他要带毯子，不是女士，所以B选项错误。 C. Drinks 饮料。女士明确说“I'll bring some drinks”，所以C选项正确。 D. A book 书。对话中未提及书，所以D选项错误。
